message.text:
I need to identify which memo lifecycle events trigger webhooks, their dispatch function names, and where all delivery converges.

I'll examine memo_service_webhooks.go and search for all memo-related webhook dispatch calls.

All required information has been gathered. The memo lifecycle events and their dispatch functions are being listed.

Four lifecycle events dispatch webhooks:

- memos.memo.created → DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
- memos.memo.updated → DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
- memos.memo.deleted → DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
- memos.memo.comment.created → DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook

Created, updated, and deleted events converge through dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook. All four ultimately call webhook.PostAsync in internal/webhook/webhook.go. PostAsync queues to asyncPostQueue, and workers call Post() for HTTP delivery.
